scope: Conditional architecture derivation and bounded reference model; no project runtime/build test.

omnia_disconnected_state_views.note: These are views/stores, not three existing canonical heads.

source_derived_counterexamples.violated_implication: Unknown judge produces a non-authorizing verdict

source_derived_counterexamples.violated_requirement: Complete mediation at public execution boundary

model_assumptions: Graph is proposed architecture, not an exhaustive discovered runtime graph.
Every modeled mutation entrypoint actually follows the declared edges; unmodeled bypasses invalidate the conclusion.
Typed transition boundary is a logical responsibility, not a required single global daemon/database.
Host policy decisions are bound to exact requests and adapter preconditions; model output carries no grant.
CAS model steps represent one atomic local transaction per workspace replica; distributed offline heads are not globally serialized.

local_cas_reference_model.invariant: At most one distinct publication per expected local generation; success advances generation. Identical retries refer to an existing operation receipt.

limits: Finite model checks do not verify filesystem ordering, SQLite behavior, native callbacks, authentication, concurrency implementation or hardware.
A cut in a deliberately proposed graph cannot identify a hidden universal component in current source.
Language/database/topology choices remain constrained design decisions rather than unique mathematical consequences.
